Renaissance

1Scōtia: long o (Lewis & Short scŏtia, another word (a moulding)). Lewis & Short s.v. Scōti: Scōtia, the land of the Scots, with the long vowel of the people’s name.

Scōtia1, Scōtiae f.

noun, first declension

In late antiquity Scōtia meant Ireland (Isid. 14.6.6, Lewis & Short s.v. Scoti). A country takes a preposition: in Scōtiam (to), in Scōtiā (in), ē Scōtiā (from).
